source: Owner direct chat after discussing when to implement environmental destruction
owner_message_original: Расчленение наверное можно будет делать уже в последюнюю очередь, важен хороший ИИ, стрельбя и разрушаемость
owner_message_english_translation: Dismemberment can probably be done last; good AI, shooting and destruction are important.
decision: Prioritize combat AI, shooting quality and environmental destruction. Defer MSQ-73 advanced body damage and dismemberment until after the priority combat work; it must not block destruction or acceptance of that combat slice.
administrative_scope: Update the current plans and existing Multica issues without dispatch. Move MSQ-73 from native stage 7 to the final existing-family expansion stage 16 and low priority, retaining MSQ-72 as its technical prerequisite. Change MSQ-74's prerequisite from MSQ-73 to MSQ-72 and raise its priority to high. Preserve other native stage numbers, leaving stage 7 vacant.
acceptance_scope: Existing regional damage, hit reactions, death and ragdoll remain part of combat. Advanced wounds and limb separation are deferred, explicit exclusions from the initial MSQ-78/MSQ-81 slice, not completed criteria. MSQ-73 later owns its affected integration checks with the delivered combat and abilities.
sequencing_limits: The detailed placement of destruction among AI packages remains a controller recommendation. This preference does not approve every proposed AI design, select assets, start production, or change the owner's gameplay-testing reservation. MSQ-111 retains MSQ-109 and MSQ-74 as prerequisites; MSQ-95/96 and MSQ-78 retain actual rubble-support/traversal scope.
supersedes: The original MSQ-73-before-MSQ-74 ordering and mandatory advanced body-damage/separation acceptance in the initial integrated combat slice only. Preserve historical approvals and setup evidence unchanged.
preservation: Preserve owner edits, current gameplay/editor state, existing assets, task status/assignment/run history, unrelated metadata and source/evidence history.
review_route: Small administrative correction: controller self-checks and acceptance with bounded read-only dependency advice; no implementation or independent technical review run.
